title: CobbleRogue - RogueRestart
body:
When a **player dies*** in game, **Pokemon** in their Party and PC are **reset** using the following command from [Cobblemon - CobbleRogue](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblerogue)!
> **_/cobblerogue restartrun confirm_**

*To be compatible with other datapacks/mods RogueRestart does not track your death count.\
Projects that do, like [Roguecraft](https://modrinth.com/datapack/rogue-craft), are required for this datapack to function.\
Not yet tested with anything other than [Roguecraft](https://modrinth.com/datapack/rogue-craft).\
[CobbleRogue](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblerogue) and [Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon) are, of course, dependencies as well :)\
Features a whole 4 lines of vanilla datapack code!

If Pixelcite needs me to take this down, I'm able.\
I hope this is added to CobbleRogue for roguelike compatibility, or as a config option.
